verdict.rationale: Codex CLI supports scriptable, non-interactive-style usage (e.g. `--search` flag for a single run, `--cd` to set working directory, config.toml for MCP scoping) and scheduled/background tasks and event-triggered automations exist for the hosted ChatGPT product, suggesting some headless/CI-style automation. However there is no documented CI integration (e.g. GitHub Actions example), no explicit 'headless mode' or non-interactive flag set beyond --search, and no evidence of exit codes, scripting API, or CI pipeline usage. missing for 10: explicit CI/headless mode documentation, exit-code/scripting API details, third-party CI integration examples, independent verification of automation working in pipelines.
